item.title: Request-Reply Pattern with ReplyingKafkaTemplate
item.description: When Kafka Needs to Be Synchronous Kafka is designed for asynchronous event streaming. But some flows genuinely need a response: a payment validation service that must confirm before the order proceeds, or a pricing engine that must return the current price before checkout completes. ReplyingKafkaTemplate gives you a blocking send-and-receive call over Kafka without leaving the Kafka ecosystem.
